guidance: Now let me turn to the guidance for FY27.
Building on the momentum we are seeing across the platform, we are revising FY27 guidance.
risks: Travel hub held firm across our major markets with the FIFA World Cup lifting activity in North America, even as the Middle East continues to face uncertainty.
So, scaling that the new entities contributing 30% might be a difficult and challenging number to come up with as synergies are coming from both the side, Adara as well as Sojern.
focus: We saw healthy growth across key accounts in the North American market and within co -op programs, which we continue to focus on and scale.
APMEA delivered its strongest ever quarter for new customer wins, up 200% year-on-year.
On sequential basis, revenue grew 9.7% over Q4 FY26, capturing the underlying momentum and focus on growth.
